description: This file defines a utility function for subscribing to real-time database changes via a Supabase client. It exports an async function that manages channel subscriptions and handles change events for specified tables with optional filtering.

methods.name: subscribeToTableChanges({ table, filter, onChange })
methods.description: Sets up a real-time subscription to changes in a specified database table, with optional filtering and a callback for change events. It returns an object with an unsubscribe method to cancel the subscription.
